paper_title: MMRA A Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Granularity and Multi-Image   Relational Association Capabilities in Large Visual Language Models
caption: The number and ratio of each subtask in our MMRA benchmark. The integers in the graph represent the number of samples in each task, while the percentages in parentheses indicate the proportion of each task in the entire benchmark.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of different tasks in the MMRA benchmark. It features a total of 11 slices, each with distinct labels and colors. The slice labeled "ObservationAngle" is bright green and represents 12.28% of the chart. "SimilarMaterial" is orange, accounting for 10.33%. "SubEvent," shown in rose, and "UsageSimilarity" in a darker red, both represent 9.74% and 9.65% respectively. The "Environment," "Layout," "SimilarEvent," and "AppearanceSimilarity" categories, each colored in shades of dark teal, cream, light blue, and light green respectively, each make up 8.77% of the chart. "MentalitySimilarity," shown in aqua, accounts for 8.67%. The "RelativePosition" segment is gray, representing 7.90%, while "NearSameEntity" is dark gray and makes up 6.34%. The chart includes percentage labels within each slice for clarity and does not feature a separate legend. Although the slices are differently colored and labeled, none are visually emphasized more than others, and they do not appear to be ordered by size.
